import time

import neal


def solve_datacenter_admission_control():
    """Solves the data center admission control QUBO problem using quantum-inspired simulated annealing.

    The problem selects 5 workloads out of 9 under hardware conflict and co-requirement constraints
    to maximize total workload priority.
    """
    start_time = time.time()

    # Workload priority mapping
    workload_info = {
        "x1": {"workload": "W1", "priority": 5},
        "x2": {"workload": "W2", "priority": 4},
        "x3": {"workload": "W3", "priority": 8},
        "x4": {"workload": "W4", "priority": 6},
        "x5": {"workload": "W5", "priority": 3},
        "x6": {"workload": "W6", "priority": 9},
        "x7": {"workload": "W7", "priority": 5},
        "x8": {"workload": "W8", "priority": 2},
        "x9": {"workload": "W9", "priority": 7},
    }

    # Linear QUBO terms Q_ii
    linear = {
        "x1": -113,
        "x2": -112,
        "x3": -116,
        "x4": -102,
        "x5": -111,
        "x6": -117,
        "x7": -113,
        "x8": -110,
        "x9": -115,
    }

    # Quadratic QUBO terms Q_ij (i < j)
    quadratic = {
        ("x1", "x2"): 24,
        ("x1", "x3"): 24,
        ("x1", "x4"): 24,
        ("x1", "x5"): 24,
        ("x1", "x6"): 24,
        ("x1", "x7"): 24,
        ("x1", "x8"): 24,
        ("x1", "x9"): 24,
        ("x2", "x3"): 24,
        ("x2", "x4"): 12,
        ("x2", "x5"): 24,
        ("x2", "x6"): 24,
        ("x2", "x7"): 24,
        ("x2", "x8"): 24,
        ("x2", "x9"): 24,
        ("x3", "x4"): 24,
        ("x3", "x5"): 24,
        ("x3", "x6"): 36,
        ("x3", "x7"): 24,
        ("x3", "x8"): 24,
        ("x3", "x9"): 24,
        ("x4", "x5"): 24,
        ("x4", "x6"): 24,
        ("x4", "x7"): 24,
        ("x4", "x8"): 24,
        ("x4", "x9"): 24,
        ("x5", "x6"): 24,
        ("x5", "x7"): 24,
        ("x5", "x8"): 24,
        ("x5", "x9"): 24,
        ("x6", "x7"): 24,
        ("x6", "x8"): 24,
        ("x6", "x9"): 24,
        ("x7", "x8"): 24,
        ("x7", "x9"): 24,
        ("x8", "x9"): 24,
    }

    bqm = dimod.BinaryQuadraticModel(linear, quadratic, 0.0, dimod.BINARY)

    num_reads = 200
    sampler = neal.SimulatedAnnealingSampler()
    response = sampler.sample(bqm, num_reads=num_reads)

    # Evaluate best sample
    best_sample = response.first.sample
    qubo_energy = float(response.first.energy)

    # Calculate metrics
    admitted = [
        workload_info[var]["workload"]
        for var, val in best_sample.items()
        if val == 1
    ]
    achieved_priority = sum(
        workload_info[var]["priority"]
        for var, val in best_sample.items()
        if val == 1
    )

    # Constraint checks (3 total constraints)
    num_selected = sum(best_sample.values())
    c1_violation = 1 if num_selected != 5 else 0
    c2_violation = 1 if (best_sample["x3"] * best_sample["x6"]) != 0 else 0
    c3_violation = 1 if (best_sample["x4"] > best_sample["x2"]) else 0

    total_violations = c1_violation + c2_violation + c3_violation
    constraint_violation_rate = total_violations / 3.0

    optimal_priority = 31.0
    feasible_objective_quality = (
        float(achieved_priority) / optimal_priority
        if constraint_violation_rate == 0
        else 0.0
    )

    elapsed_time = time.time() - start_time

    return {
        "feasible_objective_quality": feasible_objective_quality,
        "constraint_violation_rate": constraint_violation_rate,
        "penalty_adjusted_qubo_energy": qubo_energy,
        "runtime": elapsed_time,
        "evaluation_cost": num_reads,
        "achieved_priority": achieved_priority,
        "admitted_workloads": sorted(admitted),
    }
